title: 特殊疑问句（who/what/where/when/how 引导，语序规则）
knowledgePoint: 特殊疑问句的核心语序（疑问词+一般疑问句/陈述句语序）、不同疑问词（who/what/where/when/how/why/which/whose）的用法、时态适配（一般现在/过去/将来时）、主谓一致、特殊疑问句的答句逻辑

questions.question: ______ designed the new campus library? Its unique architecture has attracted widespread attention from architectural experts.
questions.explanation: 疑问词在句中作主语，询问“谁设计了图书馆”，用主格“Who”；“Whom”是宾格，需作宾语，此处不符合；“What”询问事物，“Which”询问选择，均不匹配。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 疑问词作主语时，特殊疑问句用“疑问词+陈述句语序”（无需助动词），如“Who broke the glass?”。

questions.question: How long has it taken you to complete the research project? The professor asked us to finish it within three months.
questions.explanation: “How long”询问持续时间，后接现在完成时的一般疑问句语序（has it taken），语法正确；答句逻辑与问句一致，表述通顺。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 询问“多久”用“How long”，搭配完成时或延续性动词的一般时态，如“How long have you lived here?”。

questions.question: ______ did the company launch its new product line? I heard it was released shortly after the international trade fair.
questions.explanation: 答句“在国际贸易博览会后不久发布”提示问句询问“时间”，用“When”；“Where”问地点，“Why”问原因，“How”问方式，均不匹配。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 询问具体时间点或时间段的起点，用“When”；询问持续时间用“How long”，需注意区分。

questions.question: What kind of books are you interested in? I prefer historical novels that reflect real social backgrounds.
questions.explanation: “What kind of”询问“何种类型”，后接一般疑问句语序（are you interested in），语法正确；答句回应问句的“书籍类型”，逻辑连贯。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 询问“类型/种类”用“What kind of+名词”，如“What kind of music do you like?”。

questions.question: ______ did the team overcome the technical difficulties in the experiment? Their perseverance and professional knowledge played a key role.
questions.explanation: 答句“毅力和专业知识起关键作用”提示问句询问“方式/方法”，用“How”；“Why”问原因，“What”问事物，“Which”问选择，均不匹配。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 询问“方式/方法”用“How”，答句需说明具体手段或过程，如“How did you solve the problem?”。

questions.question: Whose laptop is this left in the meeting room? Please contact the administrative department if it belongs to you.
questions.explanation: 疑问词“Whose”后接名词“laptop”，语序应为“Whose laptop is this left in the meeting room?”，但“left”为过去分词作定语，应放在名词后，正确表达为“Whose laptop left in the meeting room is this?”或“Whose laptop is this that was left in the meeting room?”，题干语序混乱。
questions.knowledgeExtension: “Whose+名词”引导的特殊疑问句，定语需置于名词后，避免语序错误，如“Whose bag with a red strap is this?”。

questions.question: ______ of the two research papers do you think is more valuable for our project? We need to select one for further analysis.
questions.explanation: 问句限定范围“two research papers”，询问“哪一个”，用“Which”；“What”无选择范围，“Who/Whom”询问人，均不符合。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 限定选择范围（两者或三者及以上）时用“Which”，无范围时用“What”，如“Which color do you prefer, red or blue?”。

questions.question: Where will the international conference be held next year? It is reported that it will take place in Geneva, Switzerland.
questions.explanation: “Where”询问地点，后接一般将来时的被动语态一般疑问句语序（will the international conference be held），语法正确；答句回应地点，逻辑通顺。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 被动语态的特殊疑问句结构：疑问词+be动词/助动词+主语+过去分词，如“Where was the letter sent?”。

questions.question: ______ do you think the government should prioritize to improve people’s quality of life? Education and healthcare are widely discussed.
questions.explanation: 问句无明确选择范围，询问“政府应优先关注什么”，用“What”；“Which”需限定范围，“Who”询问人，“How”询问方式，均不匹配。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 无选择范围时，询问“事物/内容”用“What”，如“What measures should we take?”。

questions.question: Why didn’t you attend the team meeting yesterday? I had to deal with an urgent client issue that couldn’t be postponed.
questions.explanation: “Why”询问原因，后接一般过去时的否定疑问句语序（didn’t you attend），语法正确；答句说明未参会的原因，逻辑连贯。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 询问原因用“Why”，否定式为“Why don’t/didn’t/won’t...?”，答句常用“Because...”引导。

questions.question: ______ did the scientist spend conducting the experiment? It took her nearly five years to get the final results.
questions.explanation: 答句“花了近五年”提示问句询问“持续时间”，用“How long”；“How often”问频率，“How soon”问“多久以后”，“How much”问数量/价格，均不匹配。
questions.knowledgeExtension: “How soon”后接一般将来时，答句用“in+时间段”，如“How soon will you be back? In three days.”。

questions.question: Which subject does your brother major in at university? He is studying computer science and technology.
questions.explanation: “Which subject”询问“哪个专业/学科”，后接一般现在时的一般疑问句语序（does your brother major in），语法正确；答句回应专业，逻辑通顺。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 询问“学科/专业/课程”用“Which subject/course”，如“Which course do you think is the most challenging?”。

questions.question: ______ was the historical document discovered by the archaeologists? It was found in an ancient tomb in Henan Province.
questions.explanation: 答句“在河南一座古墓中发现”提示问句询问“地点”，用“Where”；“When”问时间，“Why”问原因，“What”问事物，均不匹配。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 被动语态中询问地点，用“Where+be动词+主语+过去分词”，如“Where was the bridge built?”。

questions.question: How many employees has the company hired since last year? More than 200 new staff have joined the team.
questions.explanation: “How many”询问可数名词复数数量，后接现在完成时的一般疑问句语序（has the company hired），语法正确；答句回应人数，逻辑连贯。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 询问可数名词数量用“How many+复数名词”，询问不可数名词数量用“How much+不可数名词”，如“How much water do you need?”。

questions.question: ______ do you visit your grandparents? I go to see them every other weekend.
questions.explanation: 答句“每隔一周”提示问句询问“频率”，用“How often”；“How long”问时间，“How soon”问“多久以后”，“How far”问距离，均不匹配。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 询问频率的常见答句：every day/week/month, once a week, twice a year 等。

questions.question: What did the manager emphasize in the meeting this morning? He stressed the importance of teamwork and punctuality.
questions.explanation: “What”询问“经理强调了什么”，后接一般过去时的一般疑问句语序（did the manager emphasize），语法正确；答句回应强调的内容，逻辑通顺。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 询问“某人说/强调/做了什么”，用“What+助动词+主语+动词原形”，如“What did she say in the speech?”。

questions.question: ______ is the distance between the two cities? It’s about 500 kilometers by high-speed rail.
questions.explanation: 问句询问“两个城市之间的距离”，用“How far”；“How long”问时间或物体长度，“How much”问不可数名词数量，“How many”问可数名词数量，均不匹配。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 询问距离用“How far”，答句常用“数字+长度单位”，如“How far is it from your home to school? About 2 kilometers.”。

questions.question: Whom are you going to collaborate with on the research project? I will work with Professor Wang from Peking University.
questions.explanation: “Whom”作介词“with”的宾语，询问“与谁合作”，后接一般将来时的一般疑问句语序（are you going to collaborate with），语法正确；答句回应合作对象，逻辑通顺。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 口语中“Whom”可替换为“Who”，但正式语境中“Whom”更规范，如“Whom did you talk to?”=“Who did you talk to?”。

questions.question: ______ do you think will be responsible for organizing the company’s annual party? The administrative team has rich experience in such events.
questions.explanation: 疑问词在句中作主语，询问“谁将负责组织年会”，用“Who”；“What”问事物，“Which”问选择，“Whose”问所属，均不匹配。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 插入语“do you think”不影响疑问句语序，需置于疑问词后、主语前，如“Who do you think will win the game?”。

questions.question: Why has the flight been delayed? The airport announced that it was due to bad weather conditions.
questions.explanation: “Why”询问原因，后接现在完成时的被动语态一般疑问句语序（has the flight been delayed），语法正确；答句说明航班延误的原因，逻辑连贯。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 现在完成时被动语态的特殊疑问句结构：疑问词+have/has+主语+been+过去分词，如“Why has the project been put off?”。
